build: ARM64 Release -O3 -DNDEBUG, C++23, same uninstrumented prebuilt OF core, no LTO

method.order: Separate persistent executables, deterministic shuffled serial order per sample; idle variants wait on stdin
method.validation: Every final local/world transform, packed render matrix/color, or bulk particle position, in canonical order; max error <= 1e-4 * max(1, abs(reference))
method.timed: World scenarios include complete update; render scenarios include actual collector and packing only; frame scenarios include both complete update and renderer preparation for the same moving entities; bulk compares AoS with SoA (no ECS scatter)
method.excluded: Scene setup, initial thread creation/allocation, state validation, process startup, GPU work
method.local_core_workaround: Installed prebuilt OF core bundles FreeImage, so the duplicate standalone FreeImage link is omitted identically in both binaries
method.opt_in: group enables owning group; parallel enables owning group plus 4 total threads for World, or 4 total threads for bulk; incremental enables snapshot cache; bulk-sync copies SoA positions to ECS then runs complete World update without duplicate Velocity integration
method.quantiles: Nearest observed sample to ranks 0.1*(n-1) and 0.9*(n-1), recomputed from raw samples when packaging
